summary: random_choice picks a random element from a list; it's not a real load balancer but can act as a makeshift one.
questions: How do I pick a random item in a loop with Ansible?
Can I use random_choice as a load balancer?

answer_card.title: random_choice lookup
answer_card.answer_md: `with_random_choice` picks one element at random from a list. It isn't a load balancer (use proper modules), but can serve as a makeshift one or add randomness.
